decision: Prepare a separately frozen, gradient-free default-versus-highest GPU matmul precision comparison on the same sixteen already-consumed development groups.
basis: The fixed v2 diagnostic completed on the configured GPU but 1402 of 1741 candidate logits exceeded the registered tolerance; all sixteen argmaxes matched. The original fit remains unsealed and failed.
fixed_scope: Same checkpoint, numeric cache, device and ordered first sixteen completed groups; no test inputs or selection by observed results.
budget: One new controlled diagnostic, at most 32 group-level GPU forwards, 16 CPU forwards and 3482 GPU candidate rows; no training, gradient, new games or official transitions.
evaluation: Compare each setting with the same CPU logits using the original atol=1e-4, rtol=1e-5 and canonical first-argmax rule; report aggregate differences, not individual data.
stop: No retry or adjustment of thresholds if identity, device, row, time or cleanup checks fail.
limit: A precision comparison can support or weaken a proposed explanation for this sample; it cannot establish the original ValueError's unique cause or qualify the model for deployment.
